sourceProbe: git version (sourceVersion on every event); live test builds a throwaway repo in os.tmpdir and removes it in afterAll

events.git.commit: one per commit in merge-base(base, HEAD)..HEAD; upstreamKey branch:<branch>:commit:<sha>; occurredAt = committer date (source-reported), observedAt = collection time; payload authoredAt, committedAt, parents, isMerge, filesChanged, linesAdded, linesDeleted, binaryFiles, paths (<=200), timeBasis, observationMode=backfill
events.git.diff: uncommitted worktree vs HEAD (numstat + untracked count); occurredAt null; upstreamKey includes a digest so each changed state is a new event
events.git.observation: oldest reflog entry of refs/heads/<branch>; branchCreatedAt only when entry is 'branch: Created from X', otherwise null with reason

checks.cmd: pnpm --filter @rat-stack/core exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (filtered to git-history|b03)
checks.exit: 1 overall from other owners' files; 0 diagnostics in B03 files

gaps: Base branch auto-detected from origin/HEAD, main, master, origin/main, origin/master; other trunk names need options.baseRef (not yet exposed through CollectInput/CLI).
Commit dates are rewritable by rebase/amend; first-observed ordering needs the store or B04.
Branch creation from reflog only; 'Created from HEAD' is reported literally.
Not registered in the dx barrel/registry (A02/A07 own integration).
Rework (same file touched across commits) is derivable from payload.paths but computed by metric owners, not here.
